Video Killed the HD-Map:
Predicting Multi-Agent Behavior Directly From Aerial Images
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote:
Video Killed the HD-Map:
Predicting Multi-Agent Behavior Directly From Aerial Images

extractions.description: The paper proposes an aerial image-based map (AIM) representation that requires minimal annotation and provides rich road context information for traffic agents like pedestrians and vehicles. It evaluates multi-agent trajectory prediction using the AIM by incorporating it into a differentiable driving simulator as an image-texture-based differentiable rendering module. The results demonstrate competitive multi-agent trajectory prediction performance especially for pedestrians in the scene when using the AIM representation as compared to models trained with rasterized HD maps.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving the efficiency and scalability of autonomous driving simulations by using aerial imagery instead of manually annotated HD maps. While this has implications for smart cities and potentially more efficient transportation, it is not explicitly focused on sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We propose an aerial image-based map (AIM) representation that requires minimal annotation and provides rich road context information for traffic agents like pedestrians and vehicles. We evaluate multi-agent trajectory prediction using the AIM by incorporating it into a differentiable driving simulator as an image-texture-based differentiable rendering module. Our results demonstrate competitive multi-agent trajectory prediction performance especially for pedestrians in the scene when using our AIM representation as compared to models trained with rasterized HD maps.

primary_category.justification: The research contributes to the development of more realistic and scalable simulations for autonomous driving. Autonomous vehicles can contribute to climate change mitigation by optimizing traffic flow, reducing congestion, and enabling more efficient transportation systems.
primary_category.quote: Creating realistic simulation environments is crucial for evaluating self-driving vehicles before they can be deployed in the real world. Recent studies have emphasized the use of learned models to generate more realistic behavior for controlled agents like pedestrians and surrounding vehicles

primary_sub_category.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on improving multi-agent trajectory prediction for autonomous vehicles, which directly falls under the Transportation sub-category within Climate Change Mitigation.
primary_sub_category.quote: In this study, we investigate the performance of behavioral models learned using aerial imagery instead of HD maps. Specifically, we record a dataset of human behavior in traffic scenes with a drone from a bird’s-eye view

applications.value: Commercial transportation- optimize freight routing and scheduling
applications.justification: The improved trajectory prediction could be used in commercial transportation to optimize freight routing and scheduling.
